source: FROZEN DEMO: paraphrased conditions from public notices, not a live API fetch

items.title: Retirement: Standard HDD OS disks
items.description_text: Paraphrased reference: Standard HDD OS disks retire on 2028-09-08. Standard HDD data disks are excluded.

items.title: Retirement: PowerShell 7.4 support
items.description_text: Paraphrased reference: PowerShell 7.4 support ends on 2026-11-10; upgrade to 7.6. Linux Consumption requires a plan migration.

items.title: Retirement: TLS 1.0 and 1.1
items.description_text: Paraphrased reference: legacy TLS clients cannot connect after 2027-05-31; verify endpoint settings and client compatibility.

items.title: Retirement: Azure Disk Encryption
items.description_text: Paraphrased reference: Azure Disk Encryption retires on 2028-09-15. Determine ADE usage, not SSE/CMK or Disk Encryption Set presence.

items.title: Retirement: VM client data export preview
items.description_text: Paraphrased reference: the specific preview exporting VM client data to Event Hubs/Storage retires on 2026-07-31; AMA generally remains supported.

items.title: Retirement: Reserved VM Instances for select series
items.description_text: Paraphrased reference: selected-series reservation purchases/renewals cease from 2026-07-01. Existing reservations continue through their term; inspect reservation orders.

items.title: Retirement: Defender for Cloud in 21Vianet
items.description_text: Paraphrased reference: this retirement on 2026-08-18 is limited to Microsoft Azure operated by 21Vianet.

items.title: Data Collector API retirement
items.description_text: Paraphrased reference: legacy Data Collector API ingestion retires on 2026-09-14; custom senders require DCR-based ingestion.

items.title: Retirement: Functions v3 on Linux Consumption
items.description_text: Paraphrased reference: the 2026-09-30 enforcement requires both Linux Consumption and runtime v3.

items.title: Retirement: SCOM Managed Instance
items.description_text: Paraphrased reference: SCOM Managed Instance retires on 2026-09-30; ordinary Application Insights/Log Analytics resources are not SCOM MI.
